questions.q: Timed mini-set Q1 : Express 0.5333... as a fraction in its simplest form.
A car worth £16,000 loses 20% of its value each year. Find its value after 3 years.
Timed (4 minutes, 3 marks): Solve 4(x − 2) = x + 7, showing each step.
questions.model: Expand: 4x − 8 = x + 7 (show it). Subtract x and add 8: 3x = 15. Divide: x = 5. Each line is a separate mark.

questions.q: What is the difference between an M mark and an A mark?
questions.a: M is for a correct method; A is for the correct answer following that method
